said: People now get an email when someone replies to their topic, with a link back and a link to turn these emails off. They can also switch them on or off from the board. Real email sending is ready: it only needs an email service address, which you add later.
see: Open it, sign in as one person and start a topic. Sign in as someone else (another email), reply to it, then open the test mailbox: the first person got a reply email with a link back and a turn-off link.
